AIG Contact Information

Aircraft Accident and Serious Incidents Investigations Contact

Welcome to the Eastern Caribbean Civil Aviation Authority (ECCAA) Aircraft Accident and Serious Incidents investigations contact page. The ECCAA functions through the AIG Unit in collaboration with the member States for the investigation of aircraft accidents and/or Serious Incidents which occur within the OECS member States of:

  • Antigua and Barbuda
  • Commonwealth of Dominica
  • Grenada
  • Saint Kitts and Nevis
  • Saint Lucia
  • Saint Vincent and The Grenadines

Accidents and / or serious incidents which occur within the above jurisdictions should be reported to:

AIG Unit

Eastern Caribbean Civil Aviation Authority
